title: 50. How can I allow participants to change (edit) their contribution?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I allow participants to change (edit) their contribution.
short_answer: If activated, this feature allows participants to change/edit their answers after being submitted.
procedure: 1. Open your survey 2. Go to 'Properties' tab 3. Go to 'Security' tab 4. Enable 'Allows participants to change their contribution' option
